scope: Selected finite identities and negative controls; not proof or novelty certification.

energy.limitation: Finite Hermitian matrices; no infinite-operator domain verification or uniform lattice moment estimate.

variogram.limitation: Checks finite covariance cancellation and sampled rounding bounds. The finite weights are not asserted to be continuum finite-energy atomic measures.

insertion.limitation: Finite mode-pair matrices and occupation sums; does not reproduce marked-cap partition normalization or a curve scaling limit.

alternating_chains.limitation: Abstract one- and two-chain inequality only; does not enumerate planar cap diagrams or prove arch spanning.

conditional_projection.limitation: Finite Gaussian projection algebra and a counterexample to a missing covariance hypothesis; not metric-graph Green convergence.

likelihood.limitation: One-dimensional Gaussian identities after reduction to the shift direction; no random-domain or infinite-dimensional convergence is simulated.
